spanish: No te postrarás a sus dioses, y no los servirás, y no harás conforme a sus obras, porque destruyendo los destruirás, y quebrando quebrarás sus estelas.

findings.issue: Hophal imperfect 2ms with a 3mp suffix is causative-passive (be made to serve them); "los servirás" is active and makes the addressee the agent.

notes: Other clauses match the packet, including the cognate infinitive-absolute pairs and plural estelas.
